slides.stem: If $3x - 7 = 11$, what is the value of $6x - 14$?

slides.intro: Don't solve for $x$. Compare the two expressions first.
slides.trapWhy: $6$ is the value of $x$. The question never asked for $x$.

slides.title: Look at the target first
slides.body:
When the SAT asks for an expression instead of a variable, compare shapes before solving anything. The target is almost always a clean multiple of what you were given.

Solving for $x$ still works. It just costs a minute you don't have late in Module 2.

slides.title: When you miss one like this, Seva tells you why.
slides.body: A content gap, a trap answer, and rushing all look identical on a score report. They need different fixes. Seva tells them apart and rebuilds your plan around the real one.
